validity.researcher_notes: P4112 is a real, well-documented object: a 30.5 km газопровод-отвод (gas pipeline lateral) and the Kokshamary GRS in Zvenigovsky district, Mari El Republic, built under Gazprom's 2021-2025 regional gasification programme. Construction start (Sep 2021), the formal decree adding the settlement to the programme (Nov 2021), and commissioning (Oct 2022, ahead of the original spring-2023 target) are each independently confirmed by 2-3 separate origins (neftegaz.ru, gg12.ru, marpravda.ru, and the federal decree at rulaws.ru). Length (30.5 km) matches the recorded value exactly. Not a duplicate of any other row in the R5 Volga roster -- no other roster pipeline touches Zvenigovsky district or Kokshamary. Caveats: the recorded StartLocation 'Melnichnye Pamyaly' (the отвод's tie-in point) is not named by any source found, though the village itself is real and in the same district; and Capacity (0.21 bcm/y) could not be independently verified this pass (see Capacity [ref] fill) because the one procurement page that may state it (etpgpb.ru) is unreachable and archive.org is down session-wide. Separately, see the classification concern below on PipelineType.

validity.recommendation: review PipelineType; every source describes this as a газопровод-отвод (branch/lateral off a trunk line) that ends AT the Kokshamary ГРС -- per this batch's transmission/distribution test, that pattern is transmission (Transgaz-style lateral to a GRS), with the downstream межпоселковый networks to the actual villages being the distribution layer, not this 30.5 km object
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records PipelineType=distribution for P4112, but neftegaz.ru, gg12.ru, marpravda.ru and the rulaws.ru decree all describe the object as a 'газопровод-отвод' feeding the 'ГРС Кокшамары' -- i.e. it runs UP TO the gas distribution station, not past it. This is exactly the pattern flagged in this batch's classification test (a магистральный/trunk-fed отвод ending at a ГРС = transmission; only the межпоселковый/внутрипоселковый networks downstream of the GRS into the villages are distribution). GEM's own P4063 (Zorkino-Balakovo) carries the identical setup and the same test applies there per the batch brief, which notes the regional government itself calls that one a transmission branch. Not reclassifying per the 'flag, never reclassify' rule -- flagging for a human decision instead. Same finding filed against P4063 by whichever agent works that row.
